versions.changelog:
- Documentation formatting has been updated; no functional or behavioral changes.
- No content changes to skill triggers or usage—this update only affects the SKILL.md file structure.

Initial release of module-tsx.

- Run TypeScript, TSX, or React directly in the browser with no build step or bundler.
- Use <script type="module-tsx"> for inline or external TypeScript/TSX code execution.
- Automatic resolution of bare imports like "react" to esm.sh CDN.
- Built-in JSX and TypeScript support; React auto-injection (no import needed).
- Optional import map support for pinning, deduplication, and peer dependencies management.
- CSS and relative TypeScript imports supported.
- Provides both dev (rich error overlay) and production builds.
- Key edge cases and troubleshooting tips included.
